title: Union interest payments (debt servicing)
definition: Annual interest paid by the Central Government on outstanding public debt, the single largest recurring item in India's Union Budget.

sources.title: RBI Bulletin — Union Budget 2025-26: An Assessment (Table 2 & Annex I)

points.evidence: RBI Bulletin Union Budget 2025-26 Assessment, Annex I / Table 2, row 'Interest Payments (IP)', column 2022-23 (Actuals): 929 thousand crore INR (929,000 crore INR).
RBI Bulletin Union Budget 2025-26 Assessment, Annex I / Table 2, row 'Interest Payments (IP)', column 2023-24 (Actuals): 1,064 thousand crore INR (1,064,000 crore INR).
RBI Bulletin Union Budget 2025-26 Assessment, Annex I / Table 2, row 'Interest Payments (IP)', column 2024-25 (RE): 1,138 thousand crore INR (1,138,000 crore INR).
points.estimate_method: Compiled from official Union Budget documents (Revised Estimates / Budget Estimates) in RBI Bulletin.
